Subject: Need to rebook NetSync demo — customer travel + ops blackout week

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Heads-up: NetSync (DEAL-43921) just told me their execs will be traveling to AWS Summit the week of May 25 and can't make our scheduled demo slot on 2026-05-26 11:00 PT. On top of that, Redwood has an internal ops blackout for maintenance May 26–27 which limits our ability to spin parallel demo infra the same week.

Net effect: we need to either move the live demo or (if customer insists) provide a short pre-recorded walkthrough + live Q&A later. I want to avoid losing momentum — they have procurement in the loop.

Proposed actions (pick 1):
- Option A: Move the live demo to Thu May 28 at one of these times: 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 BST (customer prefers mornings PT).
- Option B: Ben runs the live demo but we provide a minimal pre-recorded 10-min walkthrough beforehand; live Q&A same week but outside blackout (Mon May 31).
- Option C: If we can’t land a slot this week, send a recorded demo and offer two 30-min follow ups the week after (Jun 1–3).

Marissa — can you update the calendar and send a fresh invite once we confirm? Ben — would you be able to cover on Thu May 28 AM PT if I hand off the runbook and updated deck? I attached the current demo deck and the mutual action plan for reference.

Also tagging for awareness: if we need temporary demo GPUs outside the normal pool during the blackout, I’ll raise SUP ticket.

Thanks,
Jasmine

--

Thanks for the heads-up, Jas. I can take the live demo if we move it out of the ops blackout. A few quick Qs:

1) How firm is customer on May 28? If they prefer mornings PT, I can do 10:00 PT or 11:00 PT.
2) Do we need any special infra (LLM >32k seq or heavy reranking) that would exceed standard demo pool? If yes I’ll need the SUP ticket ASAP.

Proposed concrete slot (my preference): Thu 2026-05-28 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET. If that works, Marissa — please update invite and include a 15-min pre-call at 09:30 PT for quick run-through.

If they can’t do live, I’m fine with Option B — I can prerecord the core 10-minute flow today and host live Q&A Mon 2026-05-31 (10:00 PT).

Ben
